description: Shrink a picture's file size, keeping its pixel size. Optionally change it to JPEG or WebP, which are smaller than PNG for photos. Free, with a daily limit per account. Give the file through get_upload_link (file_id) or a public link. The result link works for 24 hours; give it to the user exactly as returned.

file_id.description: The file_id from get_upload_link, once the user has uploaded the picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP or TIFF) there.

file_url.description: Or a public https link to the picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP, HEIC, GIF, BMP or TIFF). A result link from another YangOpen tool works too.

name: compress_image
title: Make a picture smaller
